name: SGResourceBlockers::cInvalidDwordTag::IsInvalid (dword at this == -1)
notes: Name provisional. 7 bytes, `cmp [ecx],-1; sete al; ret`: __thiscall, no stack arguments, returns al = 1 when the dword at this is 0xffffffff, else 0. Only al is written; the upper eax bits are not compared (a byte return). Callers include 0x150ec0, 0x150ed0, 0x151480, 0x372870, 0x3757d0. Hooked (SGResourceBlockers_InvalidDwordTag, CRC 0xa66dfac6), not run in-game. Test: 4000 cases (edges, 0xffffffff every 7th case, random words) over a buffer with random context bytes; compares al and that the buffer is unchanged. Mutants: compare with 0xfffffffe; compare with != 0xffffffff; sign bit (>> 31 != 0); low byte == 0xff: 4 of 4 killed.
